annotations.title: Get the share link for the client

description: Returns the share link of a project (creating it the first time): the page where a client sees the model and the images, comments and approves, without an account. Also says how often it was opened and whether it was approved.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it
